mapper.sql: t.id, t.owner_id, t.template_id, t.status, t.stage, t.result_key, t.failure_reason, t.check_delay_ms, t.generate_delay_ms, t.finalize_delay_ms, t.fail_stage, t.created_at, t.updated_at, tp.title AS template_title, tp.result_caption, tp.accent_color, tp.required_image_count, tp.accepted_mime_types, tp.max_file_size_bytes
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (owner_id, template_id, status, stage, result_key, failure_reason, check_delay_ms, generate_delay_ms, finalize_delay_ms, fail_stage, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{ownerId}, #{templateId}, #{status}, #{stage}, #{resultKey}, #{failureReason}, #{checkDelayMs}, #{generateDelayMs}, #{finalizeDelayMs}, #{failStage}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
INSERT INTO task_asset (task_id, slot_index, asset_id) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{slotIndex}, #{assetId})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM task t JOIN template tp ON tp.id = t.template_id WHERE t.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM task t JOIN template tp ON tp.id = t.template_id WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.owner_id = #{ownerId}
SELECT FROM task t JOIN template tp ON tp.id = t.template_id WHERE t.owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT a.id, a.owner_id, a.template_id, a.original_name, a.storage_key, a.content_type, a.size_bytes, a.created_at FROM asset a JOIN task_asset ta ON ta.asset_id = a.id WHERE ta.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY ta.slot_index ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET status = 'RUNNING', stage = #{stage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
UPDATE task SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', stage = 'FINALIZE', result_key = #{resultKey}, failure_reason = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status <> 'SUCCEEDED'
UPDATE task SET status = 'FAILED', stage = #{stage}, failure_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status <> 'SUCCEEDED'
UPDATE task SET status = 'FAILED', failure_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
